changes: Fixed silent playback on sources that keep audio in a separate track.
Covers now show save and play buttons when you hover them, without opening the show.
New founder crown: drawn by hand in gold with gems, worn tilted on the side of the profile picture.
It drops on with a bounce, then floats, sways and catches the light.
Updates now arrive inside the app: no more files to sideload.
Fixed the source icon for HentaiHaven.
Sharper errors when a server is waking up, instead of blaming Wi-Fi.
